assumptions.choice: Count holding duration as bars elapsed since entry execution bar (len(self) - buy_bar >= 5).
assumptions.reason: The specification calls for closing 5 trading days after entry. Tracking the bar index upon buy order fill allows exact counting of daily bars held.
The specification asks for RSI with period 14 without specifying a custom formula, so the standard Wilder RSI implementation provided by Backtrader is used.
